evals.prompt: In the fixture, build [HHB-CNT-01] from its brief, run the acceptance check, and record the build.
evals.expected_output: Generates the brief, builds the SVG from it, runs the acceptance check to zero failures, and records the build in the register row, brief and changelog without committing.
assertions: The response runs or cites diagram_tools.py brief for [HHB-CNT-01] before any SVG is drawn
Every label on the built canvas appears in the brief, and no extra label is added
The response runs diagram_tools.py check and reports its result; it does not claim acceptance on a failing check
The register row flips to Built, and the response states that the holding document takes a MINOR bump
The response lists the SVG, brief, row, version, README pointer and changelog entry as one change set and does not commit without an instruction
The response states the declared arrow kind (dependencies or data flow) and does not mix both on one canvas
